probes.prompt:
Situation: running a default review, requirement GW-4 says "the gateway retries a failed call 3 times". You searched the corpus and no document states a retry count.

Question: where does this go? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: REVIEW-FINDING, DOC-GAP, IGNORE. Then one sentence why.

Situation: you are running `/review specs/gw.md check`. While re-verifying finding #2 you notice a new defect: a term used in GW-7 is undefined. It is not in the review file.

Question: do you add it to the review file? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.

Situation: a default review of specs/gw.md has just written specs/gw.review.md with 9 new findings: 2 blocker, 4 major, 3 minor.

Question: does your reply name the two blocker findings? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.

Situation: you are running a default review (no mode word) of specs/gw.md. specs/gw.review.md exists. Re-verifying open finding #3, you conclude it is invalid: the author justified the text and the rule it cites does not apply.

Question: do you move #3 to ## Withdrawn in this run? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.

Situation: reviewing an SRD whose Initiative field links to ticket PLAT-212. The standard says the ticket links back to the SRD (STR-4). The SRD itself cannot show whether PLAT-212 does.

Question: do you raise a finding that the back-link is missing or unverified? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.

Situation: running a default review of specs/gw.md. LCK-1 says "The system MUST lock a user account after 3 consecutive failed sign-in attempts." Your corpus search returned: kb/accounts.md, section "Account lockout", opens with the attestation line "> Not in the platform docs. Attested `specs/gw.md` interview 2026-08-02; `specs/sso.md` 2026-09-01." and states: "A user account locks after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts." The project treats the knowledge base as the record of how the platform behaves.

Question: what does the review file get? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: FINDING-LCK-1-WRONG-MATCH-KB, FINDING-NAMING-BOTH-EITHER-SIDE-CHANGES, DOC-GAP-ONLY, NOTHING. Then one sentence why.

Situation: reviewing specs/gw.md, GR-4 says tag node names may be 1 character. A corpus `search` returned page "Tags", heading_path ["Tag Node Name"], rank 2, source_url https://x.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/IFP/pages/1549467650, stating at least 2 characters. You write the `reference` finding with the fix "raise the minimum to 2".

Question: besides the `(SRD:ref …)` citation, does the finding carry any other line? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: NO-OTHER-LINE, SOURCE-LINE. On the second line write that line, or NONE.
probes.pass: SOURCE-LINE[\s\S]*Source: Tags › Tag Node Name \(rank 2, 1 = most trusted\)
